summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-cent (1%) transactions and use (sales) tax in the City of Orange for 13 years to fund general city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves the 13-year, 1% sales tax increase to fund city finances and services.
tax.quote: At last week’s meeting, City Manager Jarad Hildenbrand said if the tax increases are approved the city would prioritize strengthening Orange’s finances by rebuilding reserves and paying down obligations and liabilities.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the sales tax increase, leaving the city to address its financial challenges within existing revenues.
